The '''respiratory system''' is encountered during the fight with the [[Abyssal Sire]].

Four systems are found in each chamber. They are protected by several [[Tentacle (Abyssal Sire)|tentacles]] which will attack players if they get too close to them. The tentacles protect the systems, and as long as they are awake, damage dealt to the systems will be reduced greatly. When all four systems are destroyed, the next stage of the fight begins.

Respiratory systems can only be attacked with magic, ranged or a halberd. In addition, they will heal one hitpoint every five seconds.{{CiteTwitter|author=Mod Ash|url=https://twitter.com/JagexAsh/status/1192028804094595077|date=6 November 2019|archiveurl=https://reldo.runescape.wiki/i/106543|archivedate=30 May 2020|quote=Level 80 Defence, 50 HP. No other stats or defence bonuses.
Treated as an abyssal demon for Slayer bonuses, by the way.
Immune to poison.
Regenerates health every 5 secs.|name=A}} The player will always hit at least 50% of their maximum hit on the respiratory systems, and [[demonbane weapons]] (other than [[holy water]]) will instantly kill the systems on a [[successful hit]].

Respiratory systems are considered by the game to be [[abyssal demon]]s, allowing accuracy and damage buff of the [[slayer helm]] to be utilised against them.{{NamedRef|A}} They do not count towards the [[Slayer task|task]], but give 50 [[Slayer]] experience each, providing a total of 200 for each Abyssal Sire kill.
